description: Replacement of front bay window at ground floor with new to match existing; replacement of external double door at lower ground floor with new window to match the adjacent windows in style and finish; replacing the existing windows with new double glazed units to match the existing style and appearance; formation of new entrance door beneath main front steps at lower ground level; repositioning of existing stairs leading to lower ground floor level and amending the existing railing to suit the new position - where new railing is required, this will match the existing. To the rear, the proposals include repositioning of existing stair up from lower ground floor to allow for the required head height above the proposed balcony and new protection from fall metal railing to match the balcony railing; insertion of two new windows at high- level lower ground floor to allow for more natural light into the interior space; replacing existing windows with new double glazed units to match the existing style and appearance; new balcony structure with metal railings and handrail painted black; new metal stair finished in black paint with railings and handrail to match the balcony; new conservatory enclosure with one sided timber folding door with glazed panels within a solid wall construction and a rooflight above; and installation of a rooflight over the stair at roof level
